_notes: min_set_id drops old sets the source lists without a real release date (POP Series, Nintendo Promos, EX Trainer Kits...). include_set_ids: 2545 = SWSH Sword & Shield Promo Cards (dated Nov 2019). exclude_set_ids: 2374 = Miscellaneous Cards & Products. set_dates fixes release dates the source lacks (2776 = First Partner Pack). undated_set_ids are promo groups that span years (SWSH/SV/ME promos, Prize Pack Series, Southeast Asia Exclusives): no new-set rule, a card's own first-priced date is used. history_start/backfill_days/archives_per_run: price history from tcgcsv's archives. chase_min: cards at or above this price are the chase group; under min_price is bulk. buywait_rule_since: Buy/Wait rule fixed on this date; evidence after it is live.
